title: Agents Made Review 49% Slower
caption:
I've been generating my own backlog and calling it velocity.

Harvard and Jellyfish tracked 718 firms and 300 million work events. After coding agents landed: 30% more lines, 20% more commits, 23% more pull requests. Submit-to-merge went from 7.03 days to 10.5. Change requests nearly doubled, comments per PR up 35%, and the PRs weren't any bigger.

The part that got me: resolved Jira issues didn't move. The estimate rules out any gain above 12%. It held even at firms already running AI review tools.

I'm solo, so I'm also the reviewer. The queue didn't disappear, it just moved to me.

What's actually blocking you?
